presentation.label: SHORTWAVE RECEIVER
presentation.summary: The track as a distant station on a shortwave receiver: fading, static that rises as it fades, crackle, the beat whistle of a mistuned carrier and the receiver's narrow band.
presentation.overview: SHORTWAVE sends the track's mono sum through a receiver of its own design and mixes it back over the stereo dry. The station fades at random moments (FADE, RATE) and the static rises as it fades, the way a receiver's gain climbs on a weak signal; CRAK adds crackle bursts. TUNE detunes the carrier: a beat whistle from 40 Hz to 5 kHz, which DRFT lets wander. BAND sets the receiver's bandwidth from 300 Hz to 4 kHz and DRIV pushes it into a soft clip, worked at twice the rate. MIX 0 returns the dry bit for bit; every continuous knob glides.
highlights: Random fading with static that rises as the station fades
A beat whistle from 40 Hz to 5 kHz, with pitch drift
Receiver bandwidth from 300 Hz to 4 kHz and an overload soft clip
MIX 0 is the dry, bit for bit; no buffer, so it fits FX1 and FX2
usage: On an audio track, hold FUNC and press FX1 (or FX2), turn LEVEL to SHORTWAVE and press YES.
Press FX1 for the main page and turn MIX up: the track comes through a narrow receiver. Turn FADE and RATE for the fading, NOIS for the static, TUNE for the whistle.
FX1 SETUP holds DRIV (overload), CRAK (crackle) and DRFT (whistle drift). Turn MIX back to 0 for the dry.

controls.name: TUNE
controls.doc: How far off the station is tuned: the beat whistle's pitch; 0 = in tune

controls.name: BAND
controls.doc: The receiver's bandwidth, 300 Hz to 4 kHz

controls.name: FADE
controls.doc: How deep the station fades; the static rises as it fades

controls.name: RATE
controls.doc: How often the fading moves: every 2 s at 0 to 44 ms at 127

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: The receiver over the dry; 0 = the dry, untouched

controls.name: DRIV
controls.doc: Drive into the receiver's soft clip, +0 to +12 dB

controls.name: DRFT
controls.doc: The whistle's pitch wandering, up to 6 %

limitations: Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB (beta) with an effect id of its own; the card builds' non-stock ids are all claimed but 0x07, which the draft holds as a placeholder.
The receiver is mono: the wet is the same on both channels. MIX blends it over the stereo dry.
DRIV overloads the receiver on purpose: at its top a full-scale tone aliases (fx:audit, TESTING.md); at DRIV 0 every audit tone but a full-scale 9.1 kHz one passes -60 dBc.
The noises are deterministic from project load: the same render sounds the same after a reload.
Not yet run in a built image, the ColdFire port or on a unit: only in fxhost (the vendored DSP56300 emulator alone).

storage.label: DSP program / table
storage.conditions: dsp_asm: 340 program words and one 387-word P table (three 129-word tables). 45 state words in each instance's own r7 block ($00-$2c). No allocator buffer, no Y memory.

processing.label: DSP instruction peak
processing.conditions: fxhost (dsp56kEmu alone), one instance, 16-frame calls at the dearest settings: 4,140 instructions a call including the per-call setup. Executed instructions, not chip cycles; not yet measured beside stock SPRING REV in dsp_host.

impact.conditions: One instance at its dearest settings.

cpu.rationale: No ColdFire code: a cloned effect descriptor; the stock pages publish the knobs.

dsp.rationale: 259 executed instructions a sample in fxhost, below the 314 octabam's benchmark reports for stock SPRING REV; not measured under the same benchmark.

memory.rationale: 727 program-memory words on each DSP core (340 code, 387 table); 45 state words per instance in the existing r7 block; no buffer.

tests.summary: fxhost only (the vendored dsp56kEmu with the module alone, no firmware): MIX 0 returns the dry bit for bit from garbage state and with trig splits; nothing outside the audio, state and parameter words is written; init keeps r1; silence stays silent and a burst decays to digital silence; the whistle sits within 0.3 % of its pitch and holds its level; FADE, NOIS, CRAK and BAND act; MIX glides; 259 instructions a sample at the dearest settings. fx:audit at DRIV 0 passes but for a full-scale 9.1 kHz tone (-50 dBc); at DRIV 127 the overload aliases (TESTING.md). Not run in a built image, under the ColdFire port or on a unit.

license.declaration: Original DSP56300 code and tables by Semi Erendönmez, GPL-3.0-or-later. No Elektron firmware, extracted routines, tables, samples or dumps are included; no stock table is read.

access.location: Audio track FX1 or FX2 SETUP: SHORTWAVE in the effect chooser.
steps: Select an audio track with its TRACK key.
Hold FUNC and press FX1 (or FX2) to open its SETUP page.
Turn LEVEL to SHORTWAVE and press YES; DRIV, CRAK and DRFT appear on the SETUP page.
Press FX1 (or FX2) for the main page: TUNE, BAND, FADE, RATE, NOIS and MIX.
